mapper.sql: bsc.status_code_id as "statusCodeId", bsc.definition_version as "definitionVersion", bsc.business_type as "businessType", bsc.status_code as "statusCode", bsc.display_name as "displayName", bsc.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", bsc.change_reason as "changeReason", bsc.updated_by as "updatedBy", bsc.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from business_status_codes bsc
order by bsc.business_type, bsc.definition_version, bsc.status_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into business_status_codes (definition_version, business_type, status_code, display_name, system_use_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{definitionVersion}, #{businessType}, #{statusCode}, #{displayName}, #{systemUseYn}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (business_type, definition_version, status_code) do update set display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, system_use_yn = EXCLUDED.system_use_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
